summary.text: Last-named among the sons of Eurystheus king of Mycenae in Apollodorus' catalogue of those slain when the Athenians fought Eurystheus rather than surrender the Heraclids.

Homonym guard: not Perimedes comrade of Odysseus at the pit of Ocean and the Sirens' isle (`perimedes-odyssey`); not Perimedes suitor from Same (`perimedes-same`); not Perimede wife of Amphitryon (`perimede-amphitryon`). Apollodorus names this Perimedes only among Eurystheus' sons.

story.text: Apollodorus lists Perimedes last among the sons of Eurystheus whom the Athenians killed — after Alexander, Iphimedon, Eurybius, and Mentor. Eurystheus himself fled in a chariot but was pursued and slain by Hyllus son of Heracles at the Scironian cliffs.
